Make sure you have a headset or speakers and that your audio settings are correct. To check the audio settings, do the following:
  • If you have speakers, make sure that they are turned on and that the volume is turned up.
  • On the Windows system toolbar (typically located at the bottom of the screen) there is a volume icon in the system tray. Double click on it and make sure that your Windows system volume is turned up and is not muted.
  • If you are still unable to hear the audio, contact your training administrator or local IT support.
